title: rosa afzeliana f. subtomentella
intro: Rosa afzeliana f. subtomentella, commonly known as Rosa rugosa, is a species of rose native to eastern Asia and the Russian Far East. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Rosa rugosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rugosa include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a valuable plant for its potential health benefits.
